headline.purpose: 24 px bold DejaVu Sans Mono in cyan outside credential entry.

body.purpose: 18 px DejaVu Sans body, ordinary buttons, status and password or hidden-network headers.

label.purpose: 14 px instructions, notices, management URLs, IP detail and Show / Hide / Clear labels.

keyboard.purpose: 19 px labels on individual keyboard keys.

previewNotes: Native Tk source in tailbridge/ui.py is authoritative. HTML/CSS snippets are visual translations for the design panel, not shipping web UI or evidence of browser, mobile or native interaction behavior.
Preview hover/active selectors display the native active palette; they do not prescribe additional Tk event behavior. The app has no transition or pressed-motion treatment.
Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH display metadata only. They are not additional shipping colors; DESIGN.md frontmatter holds the exact implemented hexadecimal palette.
The native viewport is fixed at 480 × 320. No responsive breakpoint, shadow, glow, texture, scanline, transition or decorative animation tokens are implemented.
The QR remains black on white. The readout outline is always cyan, not an inferred focused-field state.
Synthetic captures and palette calculations do not establish physical Pi usability or actual enrollment success.

native.platform: Python/Tk on a dedicated Xorg framebuffer session

evidence.type: Actual native Tk renders with synthetic data
evidence.verified: Twenty native captures pass widget bounds at 480 × 320 and buttons at least 42 px high; exact management and enrollment QR payloads decoded from captured pixels; status name/IP fallback, missing QR library, error and unenrolled states checked without clipping; documented text contrast at least 4.5:1 and resting control outlines at least 3:1. Startup PIN gate, Home navigation, masked PIN entry, cooldown, missing configuration and service recovery states checked; locking clears private state and discards stale callbacks.
evidence.pending: Physical Pi touchscreen interaction, PIN verification latency, display readability and phone-camera QR scanning.

components.description: Masked 354 × 38 px Tk label with persistent cyan outline and 6 px horizontal inset. Touch keyboard and physical keys update app state; no native Entry, caret or selection is implied. HTML/CSS is only a visual preview.

narrative.overview:
TailBridge is a dedicated appliance interface for choosing Wi-Fi, entering a
password, checking a connection and enrolling the Pi in Tailscale. The approved
default is a dark retro 1980s/1990s futuristic cyberpunk console: near-black
indigo, raised indigo control faces and precise magenta, cyan and orange accents.
The fixed landscape surface gives each task one screen and keeps its next action
in a predictable place. The character comes from color, monospaced headings and
a thin three-color lower edge; all presentation stays static.

This document records the finished native Tk implementation in `tailbridge/ui.py`.
The target is the user's Raspberry Pi 4 with Raspberry Pi OS Trixie 64-bit and a
SunFounder 480 × 320 display. Large touch controls, clear feedback and credential
privacy govern the visual choices. This design system covers the local
app-only touchscreen; ts-redir's browser interface is outside its scope.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed 480 × 320 composition with explicit on-screen keyboard layouts.
Dark indigo layers, magenta primary actions, cyan headings and orange errors.
Square, flat controls with large readable labels and visible outlines.
Three network rows per page and predictable bottom actions.
A static two-pixel cyan, magenta and orange console rail.
Credential disclosure and connection feedback built into the task flow.

rules.name: The Neon Roles Rule
rules.body:
Keep magenta for enabled primary actions, cyan for
headings and interaction cues, and orange for textual errors; the small console
rail is the shared three-color signature.

rules.name: The Static Console Rule
rules.body:
Express the retro theme through the established
palette, typography and fixed rail; preserve immediate state changes and the
untextured canvas.

dos: Do preserve the fixed 480 × 320 composition and test every changed state at that size.
Do use cyan 24 px bold DejaVu Sans Mono for standard headings and 18 px DejaVu Sans for credential headers.
Do keep magenta primary actions legible with dark text, and switch disabled actions to panel and muted colors.
Do retain 48 px network rows, 42 px action heights and 43 × 42 px character keys.
Do preserve the two-pixel rail at y=318 and the black-on-white QR with its four-module quiet border.
Do keep errors textual, preserve full network identity and clear password disclosure on navigation.
Do keep the touchscreen app-only and preserve authenticated administration and SSH recovery.
Do validate touch accuracy and readability on the actual SunFounder display before making hardware usability claims.
donts: Don't add decorative animation, glow, scanlines, shadows or desktop-style chrome to this appliance flow.
Don't let status refresh interrupt credential entry or reset network pagination.
Don't expose passwords by default or omit numeric and symbol keyboard pages.
Don't recolor the QR to match the neon palette or cover its quiet border.
Don't treat desktop captures, demo data or browser component previews as physical Pi validation.
Don't apply this touchscreen system as an unsolicited redesign of ts-redir's browser interface.
